title: Japan 2026 Consumption Tax (10%/8%), Retail Discount & Qualified Invoice 70% Credit Open Dataset and Calculation Engine
description: Open 2026 reference datasets (JSON/CSV) and zero-dependency ESM JavaScript engine published by 消費税計算JP (shouhizeikeisan.com) implementing Japan National Tax Agency (NTA) 10% standard and 8% reduced consumption tax formulas, three rounding modes, retail discount + loyalty point effective pricing (https://shouhizeikeisan.com/waribiki/), percentage utilities (https://shouhizeikeisan.com/percent/), and the October 2026 (Reiwa 8) Qualified Invoice 70% transitional input tax credit and per-rate once rounding rules (https://shouhizeikeisan.com/invoice/).
